reviewSummary: CRITICAL: Content integrity violation detected. All artifact SHA256 digests in the formalization files are incorrect - they reference expected/original digests but current file contents have different digests. This violates CON-1 (Content Address Transport) and undermines the entire WorkplaceProductionRevision authority model.

recommendation: The formalization demonstrates correct understanding of ADR-053 principles and proper architectural thinking, but contains a critical content integrity violation that undermines the entire WorkplaceProductionRevision authority model. The digest mismatches indicate that either: (1) file contents changed after digest calculation, or (2) digests were copied from specifications without verification. Either way, this violates CON-1 and makes the WorkplaceProductionRevision authority non-functional. Required changes must be completed before this can be accepted as an authoritative architecture contract.
